attitudes.label: Expressing attitude
attitudes.when: to react with feeling to a person, habit or situation

phrases.t: I get mad when she is late.
What annoys me is her hair.
If there is one thing I hate, it's smoking.

tasks.question: What kind of things about other people annoy you?

models: I get mad when colleagues arrive late to meetings.

cues.cue: people / talk / loudly on the phone in public
models: What annoys me is people talking loudly on the phone in public.
I get mad when neighbours play music late at night.

cues.cue: friends / cancel / plans at the last minute
models: What annoys me is friends cancelling plans at the last minute.

cues.trigger: if there is one thing I hate
models: If there is one thing I hate, it's drivers cutting into the queue.

cues.trigger: if there is one thing I hate
models: If there is one thing I hate, it's people interrupting while I'm speaking.

tasks.question: What qualities do you find interesting in other people?

models: I find her sense of humour very interesting.
I find his way of solving problems very interesting.
I find their travel stories very interesting.
I find her taste in music very interesting.
I find his knowledge of history very interesting.
I find their different points of view very interesting.

tasks.question: Are there any habits that really bother you?

cues.trigger: if there is one thing I hate
models: If there is one thing I hate, it's smoking indoors.

cues.cue: people / chew / with their mouth open
models: What annoys me is people chewing with their mouth open.
I get mad when friends check their phones constantly during a conversation.

cues.trigger: if there is one thing I hate
models: If there is one thing I hate, it's people gossiping about others.
I get mad when someone leaves the dishes unwashed.
What annoys me is people breaking their promises.

tasks.question: What attitudes do you notice among your colleagues?

cues.cue: colleagues / take / credit for others' work
models: What annoys me is colleagues taking credit for others' work.
I get mad when team members miss deadlines without warning.

cues.cue: manager / show / dedication to the team
models: I find my manager's dedication to the team very interesting.

cues.cue: coworker / take / a creative approach to problems
models: I find my coworker's creative approach to problems very interesting.

cues.trigger: if there is one thing I hate
models: If there is one thing I hate, it's the office gossip culture.
I get mad when people take unnecessary risks at work.
